name: CSV to SQL INSERT
summary: Turn CSV into SQL INSERT statements — dialects, batches, type inference, local-only.
description: Paste CSV and generate INSERT INTO statements. Choose table name, identifier quoting (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or unquoted), delimiter, batch size for multi-row VALUES, type inference, and empty-as-NULL. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Which SQL dialects are supported?
faqs.answer: Identifier quoting for PostgreSQL/SQLite (double quotes), MySQL (backticks), SQL Server (brackets), or sanitized unquoted names. Values use standard single-quoted strings.

faqs.question: What does rows per INSERT do?
faqs.answer: 1 emits one INSERT per CSV row. Higher values pack multiple rows into a single multi-row VALUES clause.

faqs.question: How are numbers and booleans handled?
faqs.answer: With type inference on, bare numbers stay numeric and true/false become TRUE/FALSE. Turn inference off to quote everything as strings.

faqs.question: Is my CSV uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
